formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n k : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (side : Fin n → Bool) (I : Fin k → Finset (Fin n)), (∀ a b : Fin n, G.Adj a b → side a ≠ side b) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) → 2 ≤ k → (∀ j : Fin k, ∀ a ∈ I j, ∀ b ∈ I j, ¬ G.Adj a b) → (∀ v : Fin n, ∃ j : Fin k, v ∈ I j) → (∀ v : Fin n, ∃ j : Fin k, v ∉ I j) → (∀ j : Fin k, (I j).card + 2 ≤ n) → (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b → ∃ j : Fin k, a ∈ I j ∧ b ∈ I j) → ∃ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ a b : Fin n, G.Adj a b → a ∈ T ∨ b ∈ T) ∧ G.edgeFinset.card + T.card + 1 ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, (n - (I j).card))
plain_statement: It is false that: G is a bipartite graph on n vertices with no 4-cycle. I_1, ..., I_k (k at least 2) are independent sets of G such that every vertex lies in at least one of them and in not all of them, each leaves out at least two vertices, and every two distinct non-adjacent vertices lie together in at least one of them. Then for some vertex cover T of G, the number of edges plus |T| plus 1 is at most the sum over j of (n - |I_j|).
title: It is false that independent sets covering all non-adjacent pairs of a 4-cycle-free bipartite graph always have total co-size >= edges + cover + 1
